headline: Shorts published at 07:07 IST got the most views (median 477 at 48 hours against 133 at 19:07), 31-35 s Shorts beat shorter ones, and the opening shock figure beats a question; but 99.3% of views still come from people who haven't subscribed.

working.text: Shorts at the 07:07 IST slot: median 477 views at 48 hours (12 Shorts), against 197 at 12:37 (13) and 133 at 19:07 (15), with the same 37-38% stayed to watch.
Shorts of 31 s and longer: median 211 views at 48 hours and 39.0% stayed to watch (33 Shorts), against 89 views and 31.7% for 30 s or less (14).
A shock-figure hook: median 405 views at 48 hours (10 Shorts), against 150 for a secret (14) and 125 for a question (13).

notWorking.text: Question hooks hold the fewest after the hook: 20.5% on average (13 Shorts), against 32.3% for secret hooks (14) and 38.9% for myth hooks (5).

Cinematic music: median 76 views at 48 hours (13 Shorts), against 421 for pop (13) and 176.5 for synthwave (12); stayed to watch is close (35.6% vs 37.7%), so this may be the topics those weeks rather than the music.
Subscribers barely watch: 0.7% of Shorts views in the last 28 days came from subscribers, and they watched 36.2% on average against 56.7% for everyone else.

audience.text: 47.1% of views in the last 28 days came from the US (66.3% viewed), 15.3% from India (45.6% viewed) and 7.5% from the UK (63.2%).
Men 25-34 are the largest group at 31.3% of views; teens 13-17 are 14.5% and men 35-44 14.1%.
81.4% watch on a phone, 12.3% on a tablet and 2.6% on a TV.
94% of Shorts views come from the Shorts feed and 3.2% from search.

recommendations.do: Put the day's strongest Short (the editor's top rank) in the 07:07 IST slot.
recommendations.because: 07:07 Shorts got a median of 477 views at 48 hours against 133 at 19:07, with the same stayed-to-watch rate, so the slot gets more people shown.

recommendations.do: Open on the surprising figure about a named person or business rather than a plain question.
recommendations.because: Shock-figure hooks got a median of 405 views at 48 hours against 125 for question hooks, and question hooks held only 20.5% after the hook.

recommendations.do: Keep Shorts at 31-35 s, not under 30.
recommendations.because: Shorts of 31 s and longer had 39.0% stayed to watch against 31.7% for 30 s or less, and more than twice the views (211 vs 89).
